title: [The Reel Deal]
description: Carved driftwood poles propped up about the small tent support lengths of pale sailcloth.  A dark, threadbare carpet covers a wooden floor made of deck boards.  Hanging from one of the beams, a copper lantern sways back and forth above an iron-banded oak barrel.  Tucked in the back of the space is a polished driftwood table covered with various objects.
